name: Get your transactional email activity aggregated per day
description: Get your transactional email activity aggregated per day. This endpoint will show the aggregated stats per day for the past 10 days by default if `startDate` and `endDate` OR `days` is not passed. The date range can not exceed 30 days.

limit.description: Number of documents returned per page

offset.description: Index of the first document on the page

startDate.description: **Mandatory if endDate is used.** Starting date of the report (YYYY-MM-DD)

endDate.description: **Mandatory if startDate is used.** Ending date of the report (YYYY-MM-DD)

days.description: Number of days in the past including today (positive integer, maximum 30). _Not compatible with 'startDate' and 'endDate'_

sort.title: SmtpStatisticsReportsGetParametersSort
sort.description: Sort the results in the ascending/descending order of record creation. Default order is **descending** if `sort` is not passed

blocked.description: Number of blocked emails for the date

clicks.description: Number of clicks for the date

delivered.description: Number of delivered emails for the date

hardBounces.description: Number of hardbounces for the date

invalid.description: Number of invalid emails for the date

opens.description: Number of openings for the date

requests.description: Number of requests for the date

softBounces.description: Number of softbounces for the date

spamReports.description: Number of complaints (spam reports) for the date

uniqueClicks.description: Number of unique clicks for the date

uniqueOpens.description: Number of unique openings for the date

unsubscribed.description: Number of unsubscribed emails for the date

execution.auth: API key in the api-key header, or OAuth 2.0. Not included here.
